svg.title: The guide cross term and square complete both bill squares, bill being entry minus guide. Thus workF is direct times flaw plus those two half-squares. Without a retention premise, workI is penalty times flaw(V Q−1) plus its single bill half-square, with actual Q = prediction(U, k) and the same guide. Affine accuracy bounds entry by M of rate −1/2 and bill-minus-reply by E of rate −1; sub- tracting the same guide leaves that affine error unchanged. The coarse maximum bounds guide by A fiery, so bill has size m = M + A fiery. Factoring squared norms gives 1
